Description

Today’s Aussie V8s meet current USV8 American muscle and historic USV8 attitude at one legendary US track. Nine V8s, two iconic layouts, one Power Pack.

The V8 Power Pack brings three distinct breeds of big-engine V8 racing to Project Motor Racing, then sends all nine icons to Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta for fast, flowing, full-noise action.

In V8 Evo, today’s Aussie V8s come to PMR with the 2023 Chevrolet Camaro AU and 2023 Ford Mustang AU: rear-wheel drive, big brakes, serious aero, and the kind of door-to-door commitment that makes every corner feel personal.

In USV8, the 2022 Chevrolet Camaro, 2022 Dodge Challenger, and 2022 Ford Mustang battle it out in loud muscle-car silhouette action: close, physical, and refreshingly short on excuses.

Then Historic USV8 brings the mythical roots of American road racing to sim racers: the incomparable 1971 AMC Javelin, 1970 Ford Mustang Boss 302, 1970 Plymouth Barracuda, and fabled 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Z/28. Mechanical grip, body roll, throttle steering, live rear axles, and the kind of acid-dipped chaos only US road-racing could get away with. Sideways action strongly encouraged.

Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta ties it all together. Home of Petit Le Mans, famous for fast esses, heavy braking zones, blind crests, and kerbs that will happily judge your suspension, nerve, and confidence.

Nine cars. Three V8 classes. One track. Earplugs not included.
